profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMorgan Chase & Co. | Fullstack, Cloud, AI/ML
profile.summary:
With over four years of combined experience in software engineering and mechanical engineering, I am a versatile and adaptable professional who can contribute to various domains and industries. I have a strong background in robotics as well as certifications in Fundamentals of Engineering, AWS Solution Architect, and Hashicorp Terraform.

Currently, I am a software engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co., where I leverage my research expertise in connected and automated vehicles, multi-robotic systems, Internet of Things, and renewable energies to explore and implement innovative technologies and solutions. Passionate about continual learning and complex problem-solving that have a positive impact on society and the environment, sprinkled with some fun and artistry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead full-stack development across 8+ micro frontends and 5+ microservices, driving Angular modernization, dependency upgrades, and vulnerability remediation
• Established pre-refinement sessions to align team on upcoming work, reducing sprint carryover by 60%
• Spearheaded migration of end-to-end testing from Cypress to Playwright, partnering with QA to strengthen automation and release stability

positions.title: Teacher & Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•	Supervised staff and students, proctored exams, entered & filed data, managed incoming communication and tutored students from kindergarten to post-college in customized learning plans
•	Subjects | ASVAB, ACT, SAT, Basic Math, Algebra, Geometry, Statistics, Calculus, Phonics, Reading, Writing, Vocabulary, Literature, Language, Study Skills, General Science, Biology, Chemistry, Circuits, Physics, History

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Managed engineering course grade books while researching on various automated machine teams

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
Designed concrete formwork for various walls and shoring applications per client request including green roofs, garages, levees, hotels, and apartments.

Calculated concrete loads (and submitted per request).

Designed pre-bid drawings for client via sales engineer.

Managed order entry per project with logistics.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Summer 2015

Wrote a test procedure manual for a pump-engine unit.

Audited builds on the manufacturing floor and documented revisions and potential problems.

Revised parts via engineering change procedures.

Modeled 3D parts from physical parts or 2D drawings for use in arranging assemblies.

Created 3D assemblies and exploded drawings for various portable pump diesel units for the sales & marketing team.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Summer 2014

Audited builds on the manufacturing floor and documented revisions and potential problems.

Designed the first prototypes for a universal pump test cart, which will allow only one cart to facilitate testing of several pumps.

Revised parts via engineering change procedures.

Modeled 3D parts from physical parts or 2D drawings for use in arranging assemblies.

Created 3D assemblies and exploded drawings for various portable pump diesel units for the sales & marketing team.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
Fall 2013

Designed driveline safety guards for the three different inside test cells, greatly improving operator safety.

Designed 8" stainless steel welded manifold system for the outdoor test pit, doubling the current test pit flow rates.

Documented the control panel and engine wire schematics for the Briggs and Stratton portable pump gasoline units for the manufacturing team.

Designed the first prototypes for a universal pump test cart, which will allow only one cart to facilitate testing of several pumps.

Assisted with unit testing and pump curve documentation for the various portable pump diesel units.

Revised parts via engineering change procedures.

Modeled 3D parts from physical parts or 2D drawings for use in arranging assemblies.

Created 3D assemblies and exploded drawings for various portable pump diesel units for the sales & marketing team.

positions.description: Duties: maintained dining room, washed dishes, welcomed and directed guests, monitored safety of guests and fellow cast members, & sorted orders to guests
